## BigDecimal

9-digit operands, precision 28. libmpdec is the C library behind
CPython's `decimal`, timed without the interpreter.

| Operation | decimo | libmpdec | CPython `decimal` | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| add | 41.1 ns | 34.6 ns | 49.8 ns | 1.19× slower |
| subtract | 43.5 ns | 35.0 ns | 49.2 ns | 1.24× slower |
| multiply | 37.8 ns | 27.5 ns | 42.4 ns | 1.38× slower |
| divide | 136.3 ns | 48.0 ns | 65.5 ns | 2.84× slower |
| round | 38.4 ns | 35.5 ns | 70.5 ns | 1.08× slower |
| parse | 87.8 ns | 41.5 ns | 80.0 ns | 2.12× slower |

In place, where neither side allocates a result:

| | decimo | libmpdec | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x += y` | 6.3 ns | 8.7 ns | **1.38× faster** |
| `x -= y` | 43.8 ns | 8.6 ns | 5.06× slower |
| `x *= y` | 53.1 ns | 22.1 ns | 2.40× slower |

## BigInt against CPython's int

CPython's integers can only be reached through the interpreter, so
these include its overhead — read the large sizes as the real ones.

| Digits | decimo add | CPython add | | decimo multiply | CPython multiply | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100 | 40.4 ns | 24.4 ns | 1.65× slower | 81.2 ns | 95.4 ns | **1.18× faster** |
| 1,000 | 55.2 ns | 85.0 ns | **1.54× faster** | 1.12 µs | 5.11 µs | **4.57× faster** |
| 10,000 | 278.0 ns | 783.8 ns | **2.82× faster** | 49.86 µs | 249.82 µs | **5.01× faster** |
| 100,000 | 2.36 µs | 7.65 µs | **3.24× faster** | 1.14 ms | 8.27 ms | **7.28× faster** |

## pi()

Each measurement in a fresh process, since mpmath and MPFR cache the
constant. Includes conversion to a decimal string, for every library.

| Digits | decimo | mpmath + GMP | MPFR | mpmath (pure Python) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100 | 7.11 µs | 40.08 µs | 38.33 µs | 28.79 µs |
| 1,000 | 60.51 µs | 95.83 µs | 70.75 µs | 152.88 µs |
| 10,000 | 1.20 ms | 806.75 µs | 656.67 µs | 5.41 ms |
| 100,000 | 32.63 ms | 14.28 ms | 21.49 ms | 172.21 ms |
| 1,000,000 | 782.84 ms | 248.02 ms | 399.05 ms | 7.998 s |
